versions.subject: Merge PR #4831 from @swachchhanda000 - Add Kapeka backdoor related Sigma rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'RUNDLL32.EXE'
selection_backdoor_path:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ':\ProgramData'
        - '\AppData\Local'
selection_backdoor_exec_1:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '.wll'
        - '#1'
        - ' -d'
selection_backdoor_exec_2:
    # This account for the in the wild variant
    CommandLine|contains: '.wll'
    CommandLine|endswith: '#1'
condition: selection_img and selection_backdoor_path and 1 of selection_backdoor_exec_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\rundll32.exe" OR OriginalFileName="RUNDLL32.EXE" CommandLine IN ("*:\\ProgramData*", "*\\AppData\\Local*") (CommandLine="*.wll*" CommandLine="*#1*" CommandLine="* -d*") OR (CommandLine="*.wll*" CommandLine="*#1")
